en.headline: Election Committee takes 225 more forms on third day
en.dek: Returning officers received 220 candidate forms and five designated-body forms on Friday, taking the candidate total to 685.
body: Returning officers for the 2026 Election Committee subsector ordinary elections received another 225 nomination forms on Friday, the third day of the nomination period, RTHK reported.

The day's intake comprised 220 candidate nomination forms and five designated-body nomination forms. The New Territories district-committee representatives subsector accounted for the most candidate forms, with 50, followed by the grassroots associations subsector with 27.

Since nominations opened on Wednesday, the Registration and Electoral Office has received 685 candidate nomination forms and 11 designated-body nomination forms, RTHK said. The nomination period runs until 20 October.

zh.headline: 選委會提名第三日再接225份表格
zh.dek: 選舉主任周五接獲220份候選人提名表格及5份指定團體提名表格，候選人提名累計685份。
body: 港台報道，2026年選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉提名期第三日，各界別分組的選舉主任周五再接獲225份提名表格。
當中包括220份候選人提名表格及5份指定團體提名表格。候選人提名以新界三會代表最多，有50份，其次是基層社團，共27份。
港台稱，提名期由周三開始，選舉事務處至今共接獲685份候選人提名表格及11份指定團體提名表格。提名期至10月20日結束。
